episodes.synopsis: Over summer break, the Meisei High baseball team reflects on the events of the Koshien tournament and begins making plans for the next year.
episodes.title: Looking Forward to Working With You

episodes.synopsis: With the third-years now gone, the Meisei High team seeks to strengthen their fielding by courting a troubled student named Nishiki.
episodes.title: Leave Me Alone

episodes.synopsis: Spring vacation means graduations, flower-viewing, and the spring national tournament—which Ryou's brother seems to be dominating.
episodes.title: Don't You Know What Month It Is?!

episodes.synopsis: The history of the Akai brothers' bad blood is revealed as Ryou makes a decision about his future.
episodes.title: Convince Him

episodes.synopsis: A near-accident brings Otomi face to face with a mysterious man. He doesn't remember his own name, but he seems to remember Meisei...
episodes.title: What's Up, Scary Stranger?

episodes.synopsis: The mysterious stranger staying with the Tachibanas decides he wants to go for coffee, but the coffee shop he is taken to is nothing like the one he has vague memories of from a time long past.
episodes.title: It's Not a Dream

episodes.synopsis: Kenjo High challenges Meisei to a practice match to try to get their measure, but Ooyama isn't happy about the idea of showing off his team's new potential...
episodes.title: Isn't It Just a Practice Match?

episodes.synopsis: The practice match between Kenjo and Meisei heats up as Touma returns in time to take over the mound.
episodes.title: Yeah, That's Their Ace

episodes.synopsis: While Masaki and Harada reflect on the tragedies Meisei has faced in the past, Ooyama organizes an intra-team competition with team positions and ramen on the line.
episodes.title: Let's Play!

episodes.synopsis: What should be an easy win for Ooyama's team in the scrimmage grows more complicated when Touma can't throw his full heat to an inexperienced catcher.
episodes.title: Don't Underestimate It!

episodes.synopsis: Tsukikage wants to talk to Otomi and Touma to get ideas for her story, but on the way out, the sibling pair witnesses something unexpected...
episodes.title: Let's Pretend We Didn't See

episodes.synopsis: As the summer tournament draws closer, Mr. Sengonbi reveals his connection to the Tachibana Siblings, and all involved reflect on what it means.
episodes.title: He's Calling You

episodes.synopsis: The qualifiers for the summer tournament at Koshien are finally underway. Due to being seeded, Meisei High gets a bye for the first and second rounds, meaning they have to wait to find out who their first opponent will be.
episodes.title: This Season

episodes.synopsis: Meisei High plays Hiryuu North, a "delinquent" team with something to prove. When Natsuno starts looking shaky on the mound, Ooyama considers relieving him, but...
episodes.title: Part 2

episodes.synopsis: Old emotions and fears rise to the fore as Meisei prepares to face its next opponent: the same school they were playing when Souichirou's father received his career-ending injury.
episodes.title: Eishin?

episodes.synopsis: If Meisei can beat Eishin, they'll make it to the semi-finals. Will the manager's preoccupation with the past steal victory from their grasp?
episodes.title: Play Hard!

episodes.synopsis: Nishimura's confident in Seinan's ability to make it through to the quarterfinals... but he wants to make sure Meisei's there to meet them.
episodes.title: It Really Is Special, Isn't It?

episodes.synopsis: It's Kenjo versus Toushu and Seinan versus Meisei for the East Tokyo Championship semifinals. Nishimura hopes that a big win will make his father's dream come true.
episodes.title: Who Is That?

episodes.synopsis: It's semifinal day for Seinan and Meisei, and both pitchers get off to a stellar start. But how long can they maintain their strikeout streak?
episodes.title: That's a Good Expression

episodes.synopsis: The bona fide pitchers' duel continues. Will both teams' pitchers really go all game without giving up a single run?
episodes.title: That's Our Best Game

episodes.synopsis: Meisei overcomes their semifinal opponents to set up a mouthwatering final with Kenjo with a ticket to Koshien on the line, but someone seems to be missing from the celebrations...
episodes.title: Just One More

episodes.synopsis: The recent tragedy casts a pall over Meisei High's final with Kenjo.
episodes.title: As Ever

episodes.synopsis: Harada is still struggling to overcome his amnesia. He tries his hand at a former pastime of his, plus reconnects with an old school chum in the hopes that this might trigger some memories.
episodes.title: No Way!

episodes.synopsis: A new Meisei team begins the fall tournament as new and old relationships are explored.
episodes.title: Counting On You
